## Specific task description

Task instruction: Click the smooth gray base switch with the right arm.

Task description: Use the right arm to press the rocker switch at the center of the smooth, light-gray base on the right side of the table, toggling it. The target is the movable central rocker; the surrounding panel is a fixed base.

Success criteria: The right arm presses the central seesaw to near the end of its switched travel, rotating the switch fully into position. Merely touching or slightly pressing it does not count as completion.

## Execution tips

- Choose the currently raised end of the seesaw, which can be pressed down toward the base, and contact its flat surface just inside the end. Avoid the narrow edge and area near the pivot to reduce slipping and produce effective turning torque.
- Narrow the right gripper to an opening suitable for tapping so the pads contact the seesaw. Approach as close as possible along the normal to the panel’s front face, avoiding the fingers hitting the surrounding base first.
- Apply pressure in small increments and observe whether the seesaw actually turns. Near the stop, avoid further pressing to keep the fingertip from slipping onto the panel.
- When adjusting the right arm pose, use the open area in front of the switch, leaving wrist clearance from the shallow bowl on the right and green pump bottle to reduce contact.
